They look curiously into the room before entering. (2) The man in the patterned shirt steps fully into the bathroom, revealing his white socks and black loafers. He stands beside his companion who is sitting on a toilet. They begin a synchronized choreographed dance featuring rhythmic hand claps, finger pointing, and torso sways.
